records.algorithm_name: P2 guarded resource word and tensor-aware DAG direct constructor

protocol.algorithm_name: P2 guarded resource word and tensor-aware DAG direct constructor
protocol.method_description: One structural route, no evaluator selection: homogeneous guarded M-V*-M resource word; otherwise critical-tail ready order with tensor-aware earliest predicted core finish. Singleton subgraphs are lowered in a common global topological order. Shared DDR contention and spill are excluded from the predictor and remain explicit falsification risks.
protocol.case_selection: Static extrema documented in docs/a/q2-nikolastarx/DAG_DIRECT.md before scoring this algorithm. 008 is known narrow-domain control; previously measured examples are development data, not a holdout. No case replacement.
protocol.failure_policy: Record every dispatched attempt, preserve exact failed plan/process evidence and no retry. Ordinary completed cell failures do not erase later predeclared cells; memory-limit or unresolved dispatch/observation failures stop further dispatch. No automatic resume of an existing output directory.
protocol.resources: One local worker, at most 4 GiB observed process-tree RSS. P1 may run its previously coordinated two workers concurrently; wall times are nonexclusive. No Colab runtime or GPU is used in this pilot.
protocol.offline_costs: Existing locked Python environment and official extraction reused. No training. Static 100-graph audits and proof calculations are reported separately; no per-case online plan or score table is consumed. Pro theory consultation remains in flight and is not code input.
protocol.comparison: Report all 24 paired makespans, bytes and outer solver wall against fixed Fang source 0b58c123cccf02fc993b741d79dcd8511e4dd38f, historical scores and certified lower bounds. Pilot subset means are not full100-case means. Independent final E0 does not compare against an online score because there is none.

timing.evaluation_precision: perf_counter seconds; ps observer and cleanup overhead included
